verdict.rationale: The IRS documents genuine machine channels: Modernized e-File is a system-to-system XML transmission rail, and IRIS offers an Application-to-Application intake for information returns. Neither is public. MeF requires becoming an Authorized e-file Provider, which can take up to 45 days and may involve fingerprinting, and IRIS A2A is gated by a Transmitter Control Code. No public OpenAPI spec exists (all candidate paths return 404), and the online form flows sit behind ID.me biometric sign-in. Missing for 10: an openly accessible public API, API coverage beyond e-filing (e.g. EIN application, payments, account and transcript access), a published API spec, and self-serve developer credentials.
